Category.title: Category
Category.description: Monthly budget limit category details associated with a user

monthlyLimit.description: Limit set for the category in the month

rolloverPreviousMonth.description: Sum carried over from the previous billing month

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Spent transaction entry logged by a user under a specific category

amount.description: Amount spent in the default currency

description.description: Description note of the expense transaction

AdditionalIncome.title: AdditionalIncome
AdditionalIncome.description: Supplementary income entry distributed equally across specific category targets

id.description: Unique identifier for the income transaction

description.description: Source or short description of the income source

distributedTo.description: Target category IDs over which the income is distributed

/users/{userId}/categories/{categoryId}.description: Secure subcollection containing personalized user categories and limit policies

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Secure subcollection of expenses registered by the authentic user

/users/{userId}/incomes/{incomeId}.description: Secure subcollection of supplementary incomes registered by the authentic user
